sn22.87:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn22.87:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vakkali kumbhakāranivesane viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn22.87:1.3: atha kho āyasmā vakkali upaṭṭhāke āmantesi:
sn22.87:1.4: etha tumhe āvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha.
sn22.87:1.5: vakkali bhante bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. so bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.
sn22.87:1.7: ‘sādhu kira bhante, bhagavā yena vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu, anukampaṃ upādāyā”’ti.
sn22.87:1.8: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.87:1.9: vakkali bhante, bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. so bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati
sn22.87:1.11: “sādhu kira bhante, bhagavā yena vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu, anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
sn22.87:2.1: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yenāyasmā vakkali tenupasaṅkami.
sn22.87:2.2: addasā kho āyasmā vakkali bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ disvāna mañcena samañcosi.
sn22.87:2.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavoca:
sn22.87:2.6: nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavoca:
sn22.87:2.7: kacci te vakkali, khamanīyaṃ? kacci yāpanīyaṃ? kacci te dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti?
sn22.87:2.8: na me bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ. bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti. abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn22.87:2.9: kacci te vakkali, na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāroti?
sn22.87:2.10: taggha me bhante, anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ anappako vippaṭisāroti.
sn22.87:2.11: kacci pana taṃ vakkali, attā sīlato na upavadatīti?
sn22.87:2.12: na kho maṃ bhante, attā sīlato upavadatīti.
sn22.87:2.13: no ce kira taṃ vakkali, attā sīlato upavadati, atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāroti?
sn22.87:2.14: cirapaṭikāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitukāmo. natthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvatāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyanti.
sn22.87:3.1: alaṃ vakkali, kiṃ te iminā pūtikāyena diṭṭhena,
sn22.87:3.2: yo kho vakkali, dhammaṃ passati so maṃ passati.
sn22.87:3.3: yo maṃ passati so dhammaṃ passati.
sn22.87:3.4: dhammaṃ hi vakkali, passanto maṃ passati.
sn22.87:4.4: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn22.87:4.6: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn22.87:5.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena gijjhakūṭo pabbato tena pakkāmi.
sn22.87:5.2: atha kho āyasmā vakkali acirapakkantassa bhagavato upaṭṭhāke āmantesi:
sn22.87:5.3: “etha maṃ āvuso, mañcakaṃ āropetvā yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamatha.
sn22.87:5.4: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso antaraghare kālaṃ kattabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
sn22.87:5.5: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ mañcakaṃ āropetvā yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
sn22.87:5.6: atha kho bhagavā tañca rattiṃ tañca divasāvasesaṃ gijjhakūṭe pabbate vihāsi.
sn22.87:5.7: atha kho dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
sn22.87:5.8: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.87:5.13: idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyiṃsu.
sn22.87:6.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn22.87:6.2: “etha tumhe bhikkhave, yena vakkali bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatha, upasaṅkamitvā vakkaliṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadetha:
sn22.87:7.2: imaṃ āvuso rattiṃ dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
sn22.87:7.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho āvuso ekā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.87:7.7: bhagavā ca taṃ āvuso vakkali, evamāha.
sn22.87:7.10: apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati apāpikā kālakiriyā”ti.
sn22.87:7.11: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā vakkali tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.87:8.1: atha kho āyasmā vakkali upaṭṭhāke āmantesi:
sn22.87:8.3: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso ucce āsane nisīditvā tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ sotabbaṃ maññeyyā”ti.
sn22.87:8.4: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ mañcakā oropesuṃ.
sn22.87:8.5: imaṃ āvuso rattiṃ dve devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu,
sn22.87:8.6: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho āvuso, ekā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.87:8.10: bhagavā ca taṃ āvuso vakkali, evamāha:
sn22.87:8.13: apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati, apāpikā kālakiriyā”ti.
sn22.87:8.14: tenahāvuso mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha.
sn22.87:8.21: yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmi.
sn22.87:8.34: yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā”ti na vicikicchāmī”’ti.
sn22.87:8.35: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vakkalissa paṭissutvā pakkamiṃsu.
sn22.87:8.36: atha kho āyasmā vakkali acirapakkantesu tesu bhikkhūsu satthaṃ āharesi.
sn22.87:9.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.87:9.2: vakkali bhante, bhikkhu ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn22.87:9.8: yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmi.
sn22.87:9.15: yadaniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi me tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti na vicikicchāmīti.
sn22.87:10.2: āyāma bhikkhave, yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamissāma.
sn22.87:10.4: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn22.87:10.5: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena isigilipassaṃ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkami.
sn22.87:10.6: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ vakkaliṃ dūratova mañcake vivattakkhandhaṃ semānaṃ.
sn22.87:11.1: tena kho pana samayena dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ, gacchati adho, gacchati anudisaṃ.
sn22.87:11.3: “passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, etaṃ dhūmāyitattaṃ timirāyitattaṃ gacchateva purimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gacchati uddhaṃ, gacchati adho, gacchati anudisanti?
sn22.87:11.5: eso kho bhikkhave, māro pāpimā vakkalissa kulaputtassa viññāṇaṃ samanvesati,
sn22.87:11.7: appatiṭṭhitena ca bhikkhave, viññāṇena vakkali kulaputto parinibbutoti.
